name: Welcome!
summary: This errand delivers a unique gift voucher to Claire Willower in the Forsaken hamlet of Brill. Honoring notable travelers upon their arrival in Tirisfal Glades, the gesture grants a rare miniature companion to accompany them through Azeroth. It marks one of the warmest greetings an undead traveler will find in these shadowy lands.

sections.title: A Rare Greeting in Brill
sections.body: Newly arisen travelers making their way south from Deathknell eventually cross the mist-laden road into Brill. Among the somber alchemists and bitter magistrates, Claire Willower stands ready to greet specific heroes who carry an unusual token of patronage. Exchanging the voucher provides a harmless pet to follow along on the long journey ahead.

sections.title: A Touch of Warmth in Tirisfal
sections.body: Tirisfal Glades is an inhospitable expanse haunted by Scourge remnants, zealous crusaders, and rot. Having a dedicated small companion following at one's heels offers a strange sliver of cheer amid the dreary decay of Lordaeron's fallen heartlands.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i have this voucher
faq.answer: It allows newly arrived adventurers who possess a special voucher to exchange it with Claire Willower in Brill for a unique miniature pet to accompany them on their travels.

aliases: who takes the voucher in brill
faq.answer: Claire Willower is a Forsaken resident stationed in the town of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. She collects these unique vouchers and distributes exotic pets to travelers.

faq.q: Where do you turn in the voucher?
aliases: where to turn in brill gift voucher
faq.answer: The voucher is turned in directly to Claire Willower inside the town of Brill, just a short walk south from the starting crypts of Deathknell.

faq.q: Is this quest available to everyone?
aliases: why don't i have this quest
how do you get the voucher
faq.answer: No. The starting voucher is only carried by specific adventurers arriving in Azeroth with recognized patronage, specifically from the collector's edition of the journey.

faq.q: What kind of companions can you receive?
faq.answer: Turning in the voucher lets you choose a small vanity pet, such as a miniature diablo, a panda cub, or a zergling leash, providing a harmless companion on your adventures.

faq.q: Does this companion fight in combat?
faq.answer: No. The companion is entirely passive, following you as an ornamental companion rather than participating in battles.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, whose existence is marked by blight, rot, and vengeance, traveling with a playful companion is a bizarrely wholesome diversion on the road across Lordaeron.
Brill serves as the primary gateway for Horde adventurers operating in northern Eastern Kingdoms, making Claire Willower's station a prominent stop for incoming travelers.
